name: AutoMatrix
description: Apply each patient's transform to their scans, segmentations or landmarks.

files.description: A scan, a segmentation, a landmark file, or a folder of them. Folders are searched recursively.
files.label: Files to transform

transforms.description: The transforms to apply (.tfm/.mat/.h5/.txt), matched to files by patient name. A patient with several transforms has each of them applied.
transforms.label: Transforms

output_dir.description: Where the results are written. The input tree is mirrored.

same_transform_for_every_patient.description: Apply the one transform given to every patient, instead of matching it to a patient by name. What a mirror matrix needs, and meaningless with more than one transform.
same_transform_for_every_patient.label: Same transform for every patient

name_output_after_transform.description: Add the transform's name to each output, which is what tells two transforms of one patient apart. A patient who has several gets it whatever this says, since otherwise each output overwrites the last.
name_output_after_transform.label: Include the transform name

content.description: How the voxels are resampled. "Segmentation" uses nearest neighbour, so no label is invented; "Scan" interpolates linearly; "Automatic" reads it off each file, which is per FILE rather than per run and is what a folder holding both needs.
content.label: How to resample

reference.description: Optional volume defining the output grid. Without it each image keeps its own grid and only its origin moves.
reference.label: Reference volume
